Because Rammohan refused to deliver the letter, Ramchandra Ray handed it to the old Nayan Chand. But after much fear and hesitation, Nayan Chand gave the letter to the queen rather than to Pratapaditya.

The queen did not show the king the whole letter. Instead, she described it as a hypothetical question—“What should we do if her husband wrote a letter divorcing Vibha?”—and concealed the truth. Later, she showed Basanta Ray the spiteful letter and led him to understand it as “a letter in which Ramchandra asks for Vibha to be sent back to Chandradwip.”

Consequently, the queen and Basanta Ray spread the rumor throughout the household that “Ramchandra wrote a letter asking for Vibha to be sent to Chandradwip.” Thus Vibha was told the exact opposite of the truth: that her husband was willingly sending her away without misunderstanding her.
